detailed_descriptions_html.en:
It's about time. You can finally reconnect with your favourite cat girl friends.

You meet up with Ari and Niko at the gym. What romantic adventures might follow from this?

Not the ones you'd expect. You never know with these mischievous cats...

Neko Waifus 6 features a soft-incremental progression system: solve puzzles, unlock skills, discover useful (and occasionally questionable) items, and gradually become a neko puzzle-solving machine.

Your choices matter - and sometimes come with unexpected rewards. They can lead to different quirky items, each giving you bonuses and helping you tackle puzzles more efficiently. Combine those items with an expanding skill tree to shape how you progress.

Along the way, spend time with your favourite cat girls, see what they've been up to, and collect an assortment of quirky items.

More puzzles. More progression. More neko girls. More questionable decisions.

◆ Rotating puzzles - twist, turn, and figure your way through increasingly tricky challenges.

◆ Choices with rewards - different dialogue choices can lead to different collectible items and bonuses.

◆ Build your skills - progress through a skill tree that makes solving puzzles faster and more satisfying.

◆ Soft-incremental progression - your abilities steadily grow as you play, without turning the game into an idle clicker.

◆ Collect weird stuff - because apparently hanging out with cat girls results in an unusual amount of loot.

◆ Neko shenanigans - catch up with Ari, Niko, and friends through plenty of silly conversations and unexpected situations.
